description: Eagles Eye - Mock Diagnosis Data for Frontend Development (Owned by Deborah)

infected_cassava.advice: Uproot and destroy infected plants immediately to prevent spread via whiteflies. Use certified disease-free stem cuttings for your next planting cycle.
infected_cassava.advice_luganda: Simbula era oyokye ebirime ebirwadde mangu ddala okuziyiza okusaasaana kw'olukonvuba lwa whiteflies. Kozesa ebiti ebiramu ebyakakasibwa mu kusimba okuddako.

infected_banana.advice: Cut down infected stems at soil level. Sterilize pangas with fire or Jik bleach. Do not transport affected suckers to other gardens.
infected_banana.advice_luganda: Temako ebitooke ebirwadde wansi ku ttaka. Yosa ebiwabyo mu muliro oba obinnyike mu jik. Tokwata bisigalira kubitwala mu nnimiro ndala.

healthy_crop.advice: No signs of pest infestation or foliar disease detected. Maintain regular weeding and ensure balanced nitrogen top-dressing.
healthy_crop.advice_luganda: Tewali bubonero bw'obulwadde oba ebiwuka buzuuliddwa. Weeyongere okulima bulungi n'okussaamu ebigimusa mu budde.
